issue: Author is matched with instr(author, ?), which is case-sensitive and not the spec's LIKE ? ESCAPE '\' on both columns, so AC2/AC3 fail for authors.
evidence: q=fowler -> instr('Martin Fowler', 'fowler') = 0, and title 'Refactoring' doesn't contain it, so the result is [] (expected to include Refactoring).

issue: '_' is not escaped (only '\' and '%'), so it acts as a LIKE single-char wildcard on title, breaking AC8.
evidence: q=_ -> pattern '%_%' matches every non-empty title, so all books come back (expected []).

issue: Off-by-one: `q.length >= MAX_QUERY_LENGTH` rejects a 100-char query, but AC6 allows 100 and rejects only 101+.
evidence: q='a'.repeat(100) -> 400 'Query must be 100 characters or fewer' (expected 200).

issue: No single-string check: String(req.query.q ?? '') coerces arrays and objects instead of returning 400 'Query must be a single string'.
evidence: ?q=a&q=b -> q='a,b' -> 200 search; ?q[x]=1 -> '[object Object]' -> 200 (expected 400 { error: 'Query must be a single string' }).
